note: Adjudicated accidental and house-orthography variants. The witnesses agree on the substantive text.

adjudicated.ruling: The typical edition's punctuation is retained. The difference marks phrasing and does not change the words.

The typical edition prints spíritui here (p. 381), with the acute beyond the antepenult, which Latin stress does not allow. The same book prints Spirítui in the Gloria Patri. The edition keeps spirítui.
